response.sql: SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: At least 10 observatory stations exist, so the query can return exactly 10 rows.

alternatives.interpretation: Show only stations that have at least one telescope.
